### Century Communities Announces Grand Opening of New Homes at Overland Ranch in Aurora, CO


September 29, 2026


Anticipated southeast development will offer versatile floor plans with room to upsize, resort-style amenities, and access to the award-winning Cherry Creek School District


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Final New Homes in Cherry Creek School District** : Overland Ranch is the last new-home community planned within the nationally recognized Cherry Creek School District, making this Grand Opening a final opportunity to buy new construction in one of Colorado's top-ranked school districts
- **Active Growth Corridor:** Overland Ranch sits in the southeast Aurora–Parker corridor, one of the Denver metro area's more active zones for new development
- **Versatile Floor Plans** : Two collections offer 10 floor plans up to 4,232 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms and 2- to 4-car garages, priced from the mid $700s
- **Lifestyle-Driven Location** : Approximately 25 minutes from the Denver Tech Center, downtown Denver and Denver International Airport, with convenient access to E-470, I-25, I-225, Southlands, and downtown Parker
- **Amenity-Rich Setting** : The roughly 370-acre development includes more than 100 acres of planned open space, over five miles of walking and biking trails, three community parks and three pocket parks, plus a resort-style pool and fitness center at the planned Silo Amenity Center and Hitching Post Clubhouse
- **Community Grand Opening** : Overland Ranch invites prospective homebuyers and agents to celebrate its Grand Opening on October 3, 2026


AURORA, Colo.


, Sept. 29, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced the upcoming Grand Opening of Overland Ranch, southeast Aurora's anticipated planned community, offering the last new homes planned within the award-winning Cherry Creek School District.


Prospective homebuyers and agents are invited to attend Frontier Fest, the builder's Grand Opening celebration at Overland Ranch on Saturday, October 3, at 11 a.m. The event will feature tours of new homes, live music, BBQ and ice cream food trucks, trivia, and yard games. The Overland Ranch model home will offer branded gifts, a keychain craft, and a giveaway.


**Homebuyers can learn more and RSVP for the Grand Opening at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/OverlandRanchGO](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4785419-1&h=2789669564&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FOverlandRanchGO&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FOverlandRanchGO) **.**


"With versatile floor plans, exceptional planned amenities, and a prime location near Cherry Creek Schools, Overland Ranch delivers both on premium home living as well as on lifestyle value," said Division President Brittany Wall. "We're excited to speak with homebuyers at our Grand Opening event to show them available homes and everything that makes this community unique."


Century Communities will offer two thoughtfully designed floor plan lineups (the Frontier and the Homestead collections) at Overland Ranch, featuring architecturally diverse single- and two-story new homes—boasting up to 4,232 square feet and including attractive features like 10' ceilings and standard mudrooms—starting from the mid $700s. New homes at the community will also be built with prewiring for EV chargers and solar panels.


Located in Aurora's growing southeast corridor, Overland Ranch is approximately 25 minutes from the Denver Tech Center, downtown Denver and Denver International Airport, with convenient access to E-470, I-25 and I-225. The community is also close to downtown Parker, offering residents established retail and dining nearby without the density of a fully built-out area.


Set on a total development of more than 370 acres, Overland Ranch will offer a variety of upscale amenities in the future, including three community parks, three pocket parks, a resort-style pool and a state-of-the-art fitness center, more than five miles of walking and biking trails, the Silo Amenity Center, and the Hitching Post Clubhouse.


**OVERLAND RANCH | AURORA, CO** *Now selling from the mid $700s*


- Two floor plan collections: Frontier and Homestead
- 10 one- and two-story plans ranging from 1,961 to 4,232 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 4.5 bathrooms, and 2- to 4-car garages
- 10' ceilings in ranch plans, plus deluxe primary baths, mudrooms, walk-in pantries, and open rail staircases
- Included designer finishes: quartz countertops, Shaw® flooring, LG® appliances, and Kohler® fixtures
- Finished basements available, plus included prewiring for EV charging and solar panels
- Lofts, studies, and other flexible living spaces available on select plans
- 12' stacking patio doors on select plans
- Planned community amenities include more than five miles of trails, community parks, the Silo Amenity Center, the Hitching Post Clubhouse, a resort-style pool, and a fitness center
- Approximately 25 minutes from Denver Tech Center, downtown Denver and Denver International Airport, and close to Southlands and downtown Parker
- Located within the nationally recognized Cherry Creek School District


**Location:**
7862 S. Amory Court
Aurora, CO 80016
303.268.8364


**THE FREEDOM OF ONLINE** **HOMEBUYING**


Century Communities is proud to feature its industry-first online homebuying experience on available homes in Colorado, allowing homebuyers to easily find their best fit and purchase when they're ready—all while continuing to work with their local real estate agent of choice. Homebuyers can further streamline the homebuying process by financing online with Century Communities' affiliate lender, Inspire Home Loans®.


**How it works:**


1. Shop homes at CenturyCommunities.com
2. Click "Buy Now" on any available home
3. Fill out a quick Buy Online form
4. Electronically submit an initial earnest money deposit
5. Electronically sign a purchase contract via DocuSign®


Learn more about the Buy Online experience at[www.CenturyCommunities.com/online-homebuying](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4785419-1&h=2658645539&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** Where is Overland Ranch located?
**Answer:** Overland Ranch is located in southeast Aurora, near County Line Road and S. Monaghan Road, with the sales office at 7862 S. Amory Court. Downtown Denver, the Denver Tech Center and Denver International Airport are all approximately 25 minutes away, with convenient access to E-470, I-25 and I-225.


**Question:** What is Frontier Fest?
**Answer:** Frontier Fest is the community's Grand Opening celebration on Saturday, October 3, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. Open to prospective homebuyers and real estate agents, the event includes new home tours, a BBQ lunch, and yard games.


**Question:** How much do new homes at Overland Ranch cost?
**Answer:** Single-family homes are now selling from the mid $700s.


**Question:** What floor plans are available at Overland Ranch?
**Answer:** Two collections offer 10 floor plans in total—two ranch plans and eight two-story plans—ranging from 1,961 to 4,232 square feet with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 4.5 bathrooms, and 2- to 4-car garages.


**Question:** Are single-story homes available at Overland Ranch?
**Answer:** Yes. Two ranch plans are offered, both featuring 10' ceilings.


**Question:** What schools serve Overland Ranch?
**Answer:** Overland Ranch is located within the Cherry Creek School District.


**Question:** What features are included in the price?
**Answer:** Every home includes modern designer features at no extra cost, such as quartz countertops, Shaw® flooring, and LG® appliances. Overland Ranch floor plans also offer deluxe primary baths, walk-in pantries, open rail staircases, and more.


**Question:** What amenities are planned for Overland Ranch?
**Answer:** Overland Ranch's developer has planned more than five miles of walking and biking trails, community and pocket parks, a resort-style pool, a fitness center, the Silo Amenity Center, and the Hitching Post Clubhouse.


**Question:** Can I buy a home online?
**Answer:** Yes. Century Communities' first online homebuying experience lets you browse available homes and complete your purchase through the Buy Now process, while continuing to work with your local real estate agent of choice.
